subproblem.title: The mass measure of a current on ℝ^P vanishes off the support of the current
subproblem.statement: Assume, as a hypothesis of the statement, (VO), the frozen type of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) whose tsupport is disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0. Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) (a current on U = univ) and let μ be a measure on ℝ^P such that M_W(X) = μ(W) for every open set W ⊆ ℝ^P. Then μ(ℝ^P \ spt X) = 0, i.e. μ((spt X)ᶜ) = 0. Conventions (as in the frozen contract and SimonGMT Chapter06): ℝ^P = Euclid P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)). For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(U) = TestFormOn U k (smooth k-forms on ℝ^P whose compact tsupport lies in U) and 𝒟_k(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U k; X(ω) is the value of X on ω; X − Y is the contract subtraction, (X − Y)(ω) = X(ω) − Y(ω) (definitional); 0 is the zero current; ∂X = X.boundary with ∂X(η) = X(dη) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply); currents with equal values are equal (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). Λ_k = MultiVector P k (continuous linear functionals on k-covectors) and |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α (Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector). M_G(X) = X.massOn G ∈ [0, ∞] is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (massAdmissibleOn U k G); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X); boundaryMassOn X G = M_G(∂X) if k ≥ 1 and 0 if k = 0. spt X = X.support = U \ X.zeroRegion, where X.zeroRegion is the union of the open W with compact closure contained in U on which X vanishes (X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W). Integrals ∫_E g dμ are Bochner integrals over μ⌞E; {d < t} abbreviates {x : d(x) < t}.
subproblem.lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → X.massOn W = μ W) → μ X.supportᶜ = 0
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step (1d) of the parent-supplied proof of cmcsd_shell_decomposition (used there for T and, in step 2, for ∂T); Simon, Introduction to GMT, Ch. 6, proof of the deformation theorem 5.1, displays (8)–(10) (book/chapter-06.txt lines 1405–1928).
1. (The complement of the support is the open zero region.) By definition, spt X = ℝ^P \ Z with Z := X.zeroRegion, the union of all open W with compact closure (contained in ℝ^P) on which X vanishes. Hence (spt X)ᶜ = Z (the complement of univ \ Z is Z), and Z is open, being a union of open sets (GeometricCurrentOn.isOpen_zeroRegion).
2. By the hypothesis applied to the open set W := Z, μ((spt X)ᶜ) = μ(Z) = M_Z(X), and by definition M_Z(X) is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) admissible for M_Z (tsupport ω ⊆ Z and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x).
3. Let ω be admissible for M_Z. Then tsupport ω ⊆ Z = (spt X)ᶜ, so tsupport ω is disjoint from spt X (Set.disjoint_of_subset_left with disjoint_compl_left). By (VO), applied with U := ℝ^P and S := X, X(ω) = 0, hence ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) = ENNReal.ofReal 0 = 0.
4. Every element of the set whose supremum is M_Z(X) is therefore 0, so M_Z(X) ≤ 0 (sSup_le), i.e. M_Z(X) = 0. By step 2, μ((spt X)ᶜ) = 0. ∎
proof_key_steps: μ((spt X)ᶜ) = M_Z(X), the supremum of ofReal X(ω) over ω admissible for Z = X.zeroRegion.
Every such ω has tsupport disjoint from spt X, so X(ω) = 0 by (VO).
The supremum is ≤ 0 (sSup_le), so μ((spt X)ᶜ) = 0.

audit.reason: The prose and type agree. On univ, the support complement is the open zero region. VO annihilates every admissible evaluation there, so its mass and hence its measure vanish. No finiteness or additional support lemma is silently assumed.
